usedFor: ClickUp and Trello both organise work. A “New/Updated Board” in Trello can create a matching list in ClickUp with “Create List”, and a new ClickUp task can be tagged in Trello with “Add Label To Card”.

bestTemplate.name: “New/Updated Board” in Trello, then “Create List” in ClickUp
bestTemplate.why: It gives every new Trello board a list in ClickUp, so teams moving between the two do not rebuild structure by hand.

watchOut: “New/Updated Board” polls and fires on updates, so one board can run twice and create a duplicate list. “Add Label To Card” attaches an existing label only.
